text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: When a person makes an explicit vow to the Lord concerning the equivalent for a human being,
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：若人以人身许愿，应将人身的代价献给上主，

text_en: the equivalent for a male shall be: from twenty to sixty years of age the equivalent shall be fifty shekels of silver by the sanctuary shekel.
text_cn: 由二十岁到六十岁的男人，根据圣所的‘协刻耳’，估价应是五十银‘协刻耳’；

text_en: If the person is a female, the equivalent is thirty shekels.
text_cn: 若是女人，估价应是三十‘协刻耳’。

text_en: If the age is from five to twenty years of age, the equivalent is twenty shekels for a male and ten shekels for a female.
text_cn: 由五岁到二十岁，若是男性，估价应是二十‘协刻耳’，女性为十‘协刻耳’。

text_en: If the age is from one month to five years, the equivalent for a male is five shekels of silver, and for a female the equivalent is three shekels of silver.
text_cn: 由一月到五岁，若是男性，估价为五银‘协刻耳’；若是女性，估价为三银‘协刻耳’。

text_en: And if the person is sixty years old or over, then the equivalent for a male is fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.
text_cn: 六十岁以上的人，若是男性，估价为十五‘协刻耳’，女性为十‘协刻耳’。

text_en: If any cannot afford the equivalent, they shall be brought before the priest and the priest shall assess them; the priest shall assess them according to what each one making a vow can afford.
text_cn: 但若是人穷，不能支付这估价，应带他到司祭面前。司祭估定他的价格；司祭要按许愿人的财力，估定价格。

text_en: If it concerns an animal that may be brought as an offering to the Lord , any such that may be given to the Lord shall be holy.
text_cn: 如所许的是可献于上主作祭品的兽类，献于上主的任何走兽，应视为圣的，

text_en: Another shall not be exchanged or substituted for it, either good for bad or bad for good; and if one animal is substituted for another, both that one and its substitute shall be holy.
text_cn: 不可更换，不可替代，不能以好换坏，或以坏换好；如果人拿一只走兽换另一只，以前所许的和以后所换的，都应视为圣的。

text_en: If it concerns any unclean animal that may not be brought as an offering to the Lord , the animal shall be presented before the priest.
text_cn: 如所许的是一只不洁，不堪献于上主作祭品的走兽，就应将它牵到司祭前，

text_en: The priest shall assess it: whether good or bad, according to the assessment of the priest, so it shall be.
text_cn: 司祭估定它的好坏；司祭估多少，就是多少；

text_en: But if it is to be redeemed, one-fifth must be added to the assessment.
text_cn: 如许愿的人愿把它赎回，除了司祭估定的价值外，还应加五分之一。

text_en: If a person consecrates a house to the Lord , the priest shall assess it: whether good or bad, as the priest assesses it, so it shall stand.
text_cn: 若人把自己的房屋，献于上主，司祭应估定它的好坏；司祭估多少，就是多少。

text_en: And if the one who consecrates the house wishes to redeem it, one-fifth shall be added to its assessed value, and it shall revert to the original owner.
text_cn: 如果献房屋的人再愿赎回，除估定的价值外，还应加五分之一，房屋才可归他。

text_en: If a person consecrates to the Lord any inherited landholding, its assessment shall be in accordance with its seed requirements: fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.
text_cn: 若人将自己的一部分田产献于上主，估价应按地播种所需要的数量；一‘荷默尔’大麦种子，为五十银‘协刻耳’。

text_en: If the person consecrates the field as of the year of jubilee, that assessment shall stand;
text_cn: 若人由喜年起，献了自己的田地，这个估价就是定价；

text_en: but if the field is consecrated after the jubilee, the priest shall compute the price for it according to the years that remain until the year of jubilee, and the assessment shall be reduced.
text_cn: 但如果在喜年以后献自己的田地，司祭应按至喜年尚余的年数给他估价，把估价减低。

text_en: And if the one who consecrates the field wishes to redeem it, then one-fifth shall be added to its assessed value, and it shall revert to the original owner;
text_cn: 如献田地的人再愿赎回，除司祭估定的价钱外，还应加五分之一，田地仍归于他；

text_en: but if the field is not redeemed, or if it has been sold to someone else, it shall no longer be redeemable.
text_cn: 但若他不但没有把田地赎回，反而卖给别人，不能再赎回；

text_en: But when the field is released in the jubilee, it shall be holy to the Lord as a devoted field; it becomes the priest’s holding.
text_cn: 一到喜年，田地应退还时，应献于上主，当作禁田，归于司祭，成为他的产业。

text_en: If someone consecrates to the Lord a field that has been purchased, which is not a part of the inherited landholding,
text_cn: 若人将自己买来的田地，而非祖业，献于上主，

text_en: the priest shall compute for it the proportionate assessment up to the year of jubilee, and the assessment shall be paid as of that day, a sacred donation to the Lord .
text_cn: 司祭就应估定这田地直到喜年所有的价值，那人应在当天支付你估定的价钱，这是归上主的圣物。

text_en: In the year of jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought, whose holding the land is.
text_cn: 一到喜年，这田地应退还给卖田的人，归于这块田地的原有人。

text_en: All assessments shall be by the sanctuary shekel: twenty gerahs shall make a shekel.
text_cn: 一切估价都应按圣所的‘协刻耳’；一‘协刻耳’等于二十‘革辣’。

text_en: A firstling of animals, however, which as a firstling belongs to the Lord , cannot be consecrated by anyone; whether ox or sheep, it is the Lord ’s.
text_cn: 至于头胎牲畜，既是头胎，应属于上主，人不能再奉献；不论是牛是羊，已属于上主。

text_en: If it is an unclean animal, it shall be ransomed at its assessment, with one-fifth added; if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold at its assessment.
text_cn: 若是不洁牲畜的头胎，人应照估价赎回，再加五分之一；如不赎回，应照估价卖掉。

text_en: Nothing that a person owns that has been devoted to destruction for the Lord , be it human or animal, or inherited landholding, may be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 凡照禁物法献于上主之物，凡人所有的，不论是人，或是牲畜，或是一部分田产，便不可变卖，亦不可赎回；凡禁物都是属于上主的至圣之物。

text_en: No human beings who have been devoted to destruction can be ransomed; they shall be put to death.
text_cn: 凡照禁物法应处置的人，便不可赎回，应将他处死。

text_en: All tithes from the land, whether the seed from the ground or the fruit from the tree, are the Lord ’s; they are holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 凡土地的出产，或是田地的谷物，或是树木的果实，十分之一应归于上主，是献于上主的圣物。

text_en: If persons wish to redeem any of their tithes, they must add one-fifth to them.
text_cn: 人若愿意把应献的十分之一赎回一部分，除物价外，应另加五分之一。

text_en: All tithes of herd and flock, every tenth one that passes under the shepherd’s staff, shall be holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 凡牛群或羊群，由牧童杖下经过的每第十只，亦即全群十分之一，应献于上主；

text_en: Let no one inquire whether it is good or bad, or make substitution for it; if one makes substitution for it, then both it and the substitute shall be holy and cannot be redeemed.
text_cn: 人不应追究是好是坏，亦不可将它更换；更换了，以前所有的和以后所换的，都应视为圣物，不得赎回。”

text_en: These are the commandments that the Lord gave to Moses for the people of Israel on Mount Sinai.
text_cn: 这是上主在西乃山为以色列子民向梅瑟吩咐的法令。
